tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: Browse or search the live, hand-curated StunList list of websites and apps. Returns name, site URL, StunList page URL, tagline, category, audience hubs and featured/changemaker flags. Read-only.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details of one StunList listing, looked up by its StunList id (e.g. "alphafold") or by the site's URL/domain. Read-only.

tools.name: get_placements
tools.description: Live paid placement tiers (Spotlight, Headliner, Stun of the Week, Showstopper) with current USD prices, the founding rate and spots left, Headliner slot availability, bookable Stun of the Week weeks, and the Solana wallet and currencies (SOL, USDC) used for payment. Read-only.

tools.name: stun_check
tools.description: Run StunList's live automated screening and link-preview check on a public URL: reachability over HTTPS, the same safety screening a submission gets, title/description/og:image/X card, and whether the StunList badge is present. Use before create_order to see if a site will pass. Rate limited per cli

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create a paid placement order for a website. This ONLY creates an unpaid payment quote and does NOT move any funds. The site is screened first; blocked sites are refused. Returns orderId, token, the exact amount in USDC and SOL, the payTo Solana address, the order's reference public key, Solana Pay

tools.name: verify_order
tools.description: Submit the Solana transaction signature for an order. StunList reads the transaction on-chain, checks it carries the order's reference and paid at least the quoted amount to the payTo wallet, then screens the site again and publishes the listing and placements immediately. tools.name: get_order_status
tools.description: Check an order's status (pending, paid, live, needs_review, expired). If the order is still pending, this also looks on-chain for a payment carrying the order's reference and settles it automatically, so polling this after paying works without verify_order. tools.name: get_dispatch
tools.description: Recent issues of The StunList Dispatch, StunList's weekly write-ups of remarkable sites. Pass `issue` for one full issue with its write-ups. Read-only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_listings, get_listing, stun_check, create_order, get_dispatch · Private data: get_placements, create_order, verify_order, get_order_status · Public sink: create_order, verify_order · Destructive: stun_check.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_listings, get_listing, stun_check, create_order, get_dispatch · Private data: get_placements, create_order, verify_order, get_order_status · Public sink: create_order, verify_order · Destructive: stun_check

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
